subtitle_hu: The man who lives here – aki, ami, amely

sections.body_hu: A vonatkozó névmás egy főnevet pontosít. 'who' emberre, 'which' dologra/állatra, 'that' mindkettőre.

examples.en: The man who lives here is kind.
examples.hu: Az ember, aki itt lakik, kedves.

examples.en: The book which I read was good.
examples.hu: A könyv, amit olvastam, jó volt.

examples.en: This is the house where I was born.
The girl whose dog is lost.
examples.hu: A lány, akinek a kutyája elveszett.

exercises.prompt_hu: The woman ___ called you is my aunt.
I like the car ___ you bought.
That's the town ___ I grew up.
The man ___ works in this office is very friendly.
The book ___ is on the table belongs to me.
exercises.explanation_hu: Tárgyra vonatkozik, 'that' vagy 'which' lehet, itt 'that' a válasz.

exercises.prompt_hu: The students ___ passed the exam were very happy.
I found the keys ___ I lost yesterday.
The restaurant ___ we had dinner last night was excellent.
exercises.explanation_hu: Helyre vonatkozik, 'where' a megfelelő vonatkozó névmás.
